outcome: Total IgA and sIgA levels in maternal milk
Total IgA and sIgA levels in infant stool
cohort: Healthy preterm infants (median gestation 26 weeks) and their mothers providing milk.
finding: Maternal milk from preterm mothers contains the highest concentrations of IgA and sIgA in the first three weeks postpartum, and while endogenous IgA production in preterm infants begins around week three, routine NICU handling practices approximately halve the amount of IgA available to the infant.
